verdict.rationale: Auth0's first-party MFA docs list One-time passwords and Recovery codes among supported factors, which covers TOTP-style authenticator apps and backup codes. Conditional enforcement is documented through Adaptive MFA, which prompts only on risky logins, and Strong Customer Authentication, which lets users approve sensitive operations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP authenticator-app enrollment, explicit step-up authentication for specific resources or actions, documentation of tenant-wide 'require MFA' policy controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
